notes: Original names, role themes and source_* values are from the September 2026 DOCX. The referenced XLSX was not provided.
Runtime version 2.0 uses cross-tier effective action budgets; source_* fields retain the original reference numbers.
Initiative is fair-random. The second mover receives an explicit opening shield: 7 against basic-only kits, 8 when the first mover has active skills.
Lucky activates only for an initial natural 6. Rerolled 6 allows a special move without Lucky. A basic Lucky move gains only +3 damage.
Animal traits inspire fictional game effects. Pixel sprites are stylized, not reference photographs.
